business_summary: Hankyu Hanshin Holdings, Inc. operates in the urban transportation, real estate, entertainment, information and communication technology, travel, and international transportation businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers various urban transportation services, such as railways, buses, and taxis; advertising services; and retailing services. It also involved in the development, lease, and administration of commercial facilities and office buildings; ownership and management of hotels. In addition, the company engages in the operation of sports businesses, including HANSHIN Tigers, a professional baseball team; Takarazuka Revue, a theatrical company; Umeda Arts Theater; Billboard, a music brand; and Mt. Rokko, a view spot that provides a range of leisure facilities, including ski slopes, an alpine botanical garden, an observatory, and a museum, as well as the exhibition event platform Rokko Meets Art, which combines the nature and scenery of Mt. Rokko with modern art. Further, the company involved in the provision of information and communications technology services, such as e-commerce and website production, systems development, solutions related to the medical field, and contract services in the development of software; information infrastructure, and optical and wireless high-speed internet services; and wireless IC tags for children, as well as operates ProgLab, a robot-programming classes for children. Additionally, it provides the provision of travel services; and international transportation services, which include logistics solutions, airfreight transport, and maritime cargo transport services. Hankyu Hanshin Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 한큐 한신 홀딩스(Hankyu Hanshin Holdings, Inc.)는 일본 및 해외에서 도시 교통, 부동산, 엔터테인먼트, 정보 통신 기술, 여행 및 국제 운송 사업을 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 철도, 버스, 택시 등 다양한 도시 교통 서비스를 제공합니다. 광고 서비스; 그리고 소매 서비스. 또한 상업 시설 및 사무실 건물의 개발, 임대 및 관리에도 참여했습니다. 호텔의 소유 및 관리. 또한, 회사는 프로야구단인 한신타이거즈; 극단 다카라즈카 가극단; 우메다 예술극장; 음악 브랜드 빌보드; 스키장, 고산 식물원, 전망대, 박물관 등 다양한 레저 시설을 갖춘 전망 명소인 롯코산과 롯코산의 자연과 풍경을 현대 미술과 결합한 전시 이벤트 플랫폼인 Rokko Meets Art가 있습니다. 또한 전자상거래, 웹사이트 제작, 시스템 개발, 의료분야 관련 솔루션 등 정보통신기술 서비스를 제공하는 회사입니다.
